put.description: Confirm or edit the posting. A changed company name runs company matching again.

post.description: Upload a PDF or DOCX file, or send pasted text in the `text` form field (IN-3).

put.description: Confirm or edit the parsed resume.

post.description: Local only (APP_ENV=local). Signs in any email with no check.

scoring_weights.description: Relative weight of each competency in the hire signal. Missing means 1.0.
scoring_weights.title: Scoring Weights

field_confidence.description: Confidence per field. Every ProfileField must be present.
field_confidence.title: Field Confidence

low_confidence_notes.description: Fields or claims flagged for reviewer attention.
low_confidence_notes.title: Low Confidence Notes

Competency.description: Scored competencies from the spec, grouped by interview type in COMPETENCIES_BY_TYPE.
Competency.title: Competency

HireSignal.description: FB-1. Ordered from strongest to weakest.
HireSignal.title: HireSignal

InterviewerBrief.description: Built by the planner before each session. The live interviewer reads only this.
InterviewerBrief.title: InterviewerBrief

JobContext.title: JobContext
JobContext.description: Optional context the user adds about the interview (IN-4). Stage has its own column.

level.description: Normalized level, if it can be inferred.

level_label.title: Level Label
level_label.description: Level as written in the posting, for example 'L5' or 'Senior'.

JobPosting.title: JobPosting
JobPosting.description: Structured data extracted from a job posting. The user confirms or edits it (IN-2).

JobTargetCreate.title: JobTargetCreate
JobTargetCreate.description:
A posting as pasted text, a URL, or both (IN-1). With both, the text is used and the URL
helps company matching.

generic_mode.title: Generic Mode
generic_mode.description: True when no curated company matched. None until extraction finishes.

JobTargetUpdate.title: JobTargetUpdate
JobTargetUpdate.description: The user confirms or edits the extracted posting (IN-2) and the context (IN-4).

Level.title: Level
Level.description: Normalized seniority (IV-6). Company-specific labels such as L5 or E5 map to these.

interview_type.description: None for rounds v1 does not simulate, such as live coding.

dev_link.title: Dev Link
dev_link.description: Only when APP_ENV=local, so no email server is needed.

Mode.description: IV-8. Only Realistic sessions count toward progress trends (PR-1).
Mode.title: Mode

Phase.description: Session state machine phases (IV-7). The session controller moves phases, not the LLM.
Phase.title: Phase

priority.description: 1 is the first session to run.
priority.title: Priority

evidence_signals.description: What evidence of this principle sounds like in an answer.
evidence_signals.title: Evidence Signals

ProfileField.description: Top-level profile fields that carry sources and a confidence level.
ProfileField.title: ProfileField

ProgressSnapshot.description: One competency score from one Realistic session, for trend charts (PR-1).
ProgressSnapshot.title: ProgressSnapshot

QuestionPattern.description: A recurring theme, phrased as a pattern. Never a leaked or NDA-protected question.
QuestionPattern.title: QuestionPattern

evidence.description: Resume text that supports the score.
evidence.title: Evidence

Resume.title: Resume
Resume.description: A parsed resume (IN-3). Contact details are deliberately not part of the contract.

rationale.description: 3 to 5 sentences, like a debrief summary.
rationale.title: Rationale

competency_scores.description: Overall score per competency across the session.
competency_scores.title: Competency Scores

scorer_model.description: Gateway model alias, never a vendor id.
scorer_model.title: Scorer Model

SessionConfig.description: What the candidate picks before a session (journey 2, step 1).
SessionConfig.title: SessionConfig

age_confirmed.title: Age Confirmed
age_confirmed.description: The user confirmed they are 18 or older.

training_consent.title: Training Consent
training_consent.description: AC-2: off unless the user opts in.

fields.description: Which profile fields this source supports.
fields.title: Fields

SubscriptionStatus.description: Mirrors the Stripe subscription statuses we act on.
SubscriptionStatus.title: SubscriptionStatus

Turn.description: One utterance in the transcript. Text only; audio is never stored.
Turn.title: Turn
